text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT REPORTED: High memory usage on kv-cache service (nodepool-3) — automatic pager sent to #oncall. Initial alert: mem_used > 92% for 3 nodes, continuous batching latency spikes.
Maya: I’m on it, paging Sanjay for runtime/quantization link.
Sanjay: reading metrics — looks like a quantization kernel change from last night’s canary increased KV entry size for gptq->awq fallback. KV footprint up ~3x for >512-length contexts.
Leah: seeing customer errors too: timeouts on /generate for some tenants behind dedicated. Error 524 mostly when cache misses force long decode.
Maya: @ops-runbot can you pin the canary to previous revision and roll back kernel flags? Need to stop more blowups.
ops-runbot: starting automated rollback to runtime:v2026-03-10-canary -> stable. Progressing...
Alex: opening a fast mitigation: reduce continuous batch max_size and force KV eviction TTL to 10m for affected pool. Will push config.
Sanjay: patch idea — quant path selection currently chooses awq-int8 for certain layers; fallback to int8-gptq increases per-key size because of alignment + different KV packing. We should force gptq path for now.
Leah: running eviction script on nodepool-3 now. Command:```bash
# evict kv prefixes older than 5m
curl -X POST "https://internal-kv-api/evict" -d '{"older_than_s":300, "prefix":"*"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Ethan: contacting affected customer CUST-42 and CUST-88 — letting them know we are aware and working a mitigation. ETA ~15-20m for rollback + eviction.
Maya: on-call handoff to Alex in 10m; I’ll stay in thread for context.
Sanjay: logs from runtime showing growth pattern:```
[2026-04-08T19:34:02Z] runtime: model=redwood-large quant_path=awq size_kv_bytes=134217728 entries=4096
[2026-04-08T19:35:12Z] runtime: model=redwood-large quant_path=gptq size_kv_bytes=450887936 entries=4096
```
Maya: that matches 3.36x growth. Also seeing batch latency cliff when batch size >32, probably due to cache thrash.
Alex: pushed temporary route-by-policy: route high-length requests to dedicated fallback model variant (smaller context) and route rest to stable. Applied via routing service.
ops-runbot: rollback complete on 4/8 19:45 UTC, runtime now stable-v2026-03-09. Monitoring.
Leah: eviction finished. Memory trending down to 48% on nodepool-3. Latency for /generate improving.
Ethan: customer update sent: "We detected a regression in a quantization kernel that increased in-memory cache sizes; we've rolled back the canary and forced cache eviction. Expecting restored performance; please escalate if you see further issues."
Sanjay: postmortem actions suggested: (1) add KV size unit tests for quant path combos, (2) make quant-path selection deterministic by model+seq-len, (3) add alert for per-model kv_size growth >2x in 5m window.
Maya: create an incident ticket and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml to own the regression investigation.
Alex: follow-ups — add an automated rollback for quant-path experiments and a canary guard in CI to compare kv footprint vs baseline.
Maya: handing off to Alex for next 60m. If anything spikes, please page pager (incident-bot). Thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-runbot: note: autoscaler triggered temporary 2 extra gpu nodes at 19:38 UTC to absorb load during the rollback window.
Maya: marking incident as mitigated, but keeping the thread open for the postmortem and RCA artifacts.
